# Progress > Determinate task progress with optional label and value rows. This file matches the installed `progress` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/progress.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/progress.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0` ## Registry dependencies - `core` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/range-knobs`: `rangeKnobs`, types `RangeKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/progress`: `Progress`, `ProgressLabel`, `ProgressValue`, `ProgressTrack`, `ProgressIndicator`, types `ProgressProps`, `ProgressTrackProps`, `ProgressIndicatorProps`, `ProgressLabelProps`, `ProgressValueProps` ## Composition ### Anatomy ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { useEffect, useState } from "react"; import { Progress, ProgressIndicator, ProgressLabel, ProgressTrack, ProgressValue } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/progress"; export function PrimitiveProgressExample() { const [value, setValue] = useState(24); useEffect(() => { const id = setInterval(() => { setValue((current) => (current >= 100 ? 0 : Math.min(100, current + 8))); }, 900); return () => clearInterval(id); }, []); return (
Indexing registry {(_formatted, current) => (current == null ? "—" : `${current}%`)}
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `progress` - `indicator`: `data-complete`, `data-indeterminate`, `data-progressing`, `data-range-kind` (`progress`) - `label`: `data-complete`, `data-indeterminate`, `data-progressing`, `data-range-kind` (`progress`) - `root`: `data-complete`, `data-indeterminate`, `data-progressing`, `data-range-kind` (`progress`) - `track`: `data-complete`, `data-indeterminate`, `data-progressing`, `data-range-kind` (`progress`) - `value`: `data-complete`, `data-indeterminate`, `data-progressing`, `data-range-kind` (`progress`) ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### range - `--cui-range-level-warning-background`: `var(--warning)` - `--cui-range-level-clip-background`: `var(--destructive)` - `--cui-range-level-muted-background`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-range-level-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)` - `--cui-range-level-scale-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-range-indeterminate-size`: `40%` - `--cui-range-indeterminate-animation-duration`: `calc(var(--duration-loop) * 1.5)` - `--cui-range-track-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)` - `--cui-range-track-radius`: `9999px` - `--cui-range-track-background`: `var(--muted)` - `--cui-range-indicator-radius`: `var(--cui-range-track-radius)` - `--cui-range-indicator-background`: `var(--primary)` - `--cui-range-thumb-radius`: `9999px` - `--cui-range-thumb-inline-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3.5)` - `--cui-range-thumb-block-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3.5)` - `--cui-range-thumb-background`: `var(--background)` - `--cui-range-thumb-border-color`: `var(--control-rim)` - `--cui-range-thumb-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)` - `--cui-range-track-dragging-background`: `var(--active-fill)` - `--cui-range-indicator-dragging-background`: `var(--primary)` - `--cui-range-thumb-hover-background`: `var(--cui-range-thumb-background)` - `--cui-range-thumb-dragging-background`: `var(--cui-range-thumb-background)` - `--cui-range-thumb-dragging-shadow`: `var(--shadow-md)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/progress - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/range.json
